answer: Lock a bond to a hardware root. Submit the attestation. If two jurors disagree, re-queue the case to a second panel instead of settling it. Trust the task, not the address: a name means nothing until it has cleared work under audit. A lazy operator forks a hundred identities and finds each one needs its own chip, its own bond, and a second panel that can still overturn it. That forge of names sends a ripple through the bond ledger, and the ocean of parked accounts never earns.
